exact_statement: For every finite simple graph G and every pair of distinct edges e,f, if F is a uniformly random forest of G, then Pr(e in F | f in F) <= Pr(e in F).
scope_notes: Round three inherits the independently audited K5-e high-triangle stabilizer-slice theorem but claims no new credit for it.
The immediate target is the previously unattacked cross-edge orbit of K5 minus the low-low edge, first on its complete stabilizer specialization.
Orbit equalization is a local mechanism test: it loses transverse independent-edge directions and cannot alone prove OPG-1757.
A negative xi point counts only if an exact path or complete chamber argument places it in the distinguished component of P>0 containing the positive anchor.
